messages:
Maria Soto: Heads-up: Support reported multiple "why fallback" tickets from EU customers. They want a clear, tenant-friendly explanation in Console traces when a request is routed away from primary model.

Raj Patel: Yep saw that. Current logs say "served variant rv2-8b-q" but no quick reason. For troubleshooting we need: which policy ran, capacity signals, and whether tier or region forced the choice.

Eli Chen: Proposal: enrich internal traces with a `routing_decision` payload and optionally add lightweight routing headers to responses when customers opt in. Internal payload example (stringified JSON in trace):
```
{"policy":"cost_saver","scores":{"primary":0.65,"fallback":0.35},"decision":"primary","variant":"rv2-13b-fp16","reason":"policy_score"}
```

Jules: From Console POV: surface a compact phrase on the trace list like "Fallback: capacity" or "Policy: cost_saver -> primary". Click to expand full decision for internal users only. Also allow download of the routing metadata in the support HAR when user consents.

Tara - eng-platform: Implementation questions:
- schema vs free text: prefer structured for internal (metrics, dashboards) and short text for tenant-facing UI
- retention & sampling: can't keep full blobs for everything
- opt-in for headers to avoid leaking routing/competitive info

Raj Patel: Metrics we need emitted: `routing.fallback_rate{region,tier}`, `routing.decision_count{policy,variant}`, and decision latency histogram. Those will power Console charts.

SRE Bot: alert: eu-west fallback_rate > baseline (last 30m)

Maria Soto: That alert maps to support tickets. If traces can link a request -> decision -> quota check we can reduce triage time.

Eli Chen: Privacy note: do not include raw prompts or un-hashed user identifiers in routing_decision. We'll redact/hide any PII. For private deployments, customers may run with full tracing; we'll document the privacy tradeoff.

Jules: UX mock idea:
- Trace list: tiny badge: Policy=cost_saver | Result=fallback
- Trace detail: timeline rows: policy_eval -> capacity_check -> final_route
- Expandable JSON panel for internal staff
- Toggle in Console: "Include routing headers in responses (opt-in)"

Support Team: For support-run HARs, adding routing headers is super helpful. We just need an easy checkbox in console to include them.

Tara - eng-platform: Sampling plan suggestion: 0.5% of successful requests store full `routing_decision` for 30 days; 100% of errors (5xx/4xx) capture full payload for 7 days; tenant-facing short reason stored for 90 days. Thoughts?

Raj Patel: Sounds reasonable. Also add a short-lived cache for most-recent decision per API key to speed troubleshooting without heavy storage.

Eli Chen: Draft schema v0:
```
routing_decision_v0 = {
  "policy": "string",
  "chosen_variant": "string",
  "decision": "primary|fallback|degraded",
  "scores": "map string->float (internal only)",
  "capacity_snapshot": "map" ,
  "reason": "short string"
}
```
We'll keep `scores` and `capacity_snapshot` internal only.

Maria Soto: Product preference: show tenants the chosen variant and a concise cause (e.g., "Fallback due to capacity"). Internals get the full detail.

Tara - eng-platform: API changes we need:
- Add `X-RD-Debug: routing` header (internal ops only) to trigger full capture
- Add opt-in API-key flag `expose_routing_headers=true`
- Trace schema field `routing_decision_v0` (stringified JSON)

Raj Patel: I will wire metrics emitters and a small dashboard tile: heatmap of fallback_rate by region and tier.

Eli Chen: I'll work on the schema, redaction rules, and TTLs. Proposal: internal blobs TTL=30d, tenant short text TTL=90d. Legal please review.

legal-team: We'll review retention and PII redaction. Initial concern: exposing policy weights could be sensitive; recommend hide weights from tenant-facing views.

Jules: UI implementation plan:
1) Add badge to trace list (cheap change)
2) Add expandable trace detail with timeline
3) Add dashboard card and filter by policy/region/tier
4) Add API-key toggle in Settings

Deploy Bot: feature flag `routing-trace-enrich` enabled in dev

Tara - eng-platform: action items:
- PR: header + sampling + schema (assignee: Tara) due in 1 week
- Metrics: Raj to emit new metrics
- Console mock: Jules to produce mock for product sync
- Privacy doc: Eli + legal to finalize

Raj Patel: Will run a small load test with sampling on to ensure traces don't explode storage.

Maria Soto: Thanks team. We'll keep the tenant-visible message simple and conservative. Internals keep the data we need to troubleshoot. Follow-up in RFC PR.

Jules: I'll add a small "explainability" toggle in mockups for product to review.

Maria Soto: Closing unless more comments. :+1:
